title: Push depth further: 10 -> 12 layers at constant width 512
description: DEPTH 10 -> 12 and ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 40, so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth change, nothing else touched.
reflection: POSITIVE but with clearly diminishing returns: val_bpb 0.986354 vs baseline 0.989007, i.e. -0.0027 (about 3x the ~0.0009 noise floor). Compare the previous depth step 8->10, which gave -0.0082. Numbers: 71.3M params (was 60.8M), FLOPs/token 3.46e8 (was 2.96e8, +17%), total_tokens 331.5M (was 381M, -13%), 2529 steps, steady-state MFU 38.49% (was 37.8% -- the MFU gain from depth has now saturated), peak VRAM 32.9GB (was 27.1GB). So a third of the previous gain for a similar share of the token budget. Extrapolating, depth 14 should be worth roughly -0.001 or less and may well be flat or negative: the depth axis is close to its optimum for this 5-minute budget and I would NOT spend a slot on DEPTH 14. The untouched axis with the most room now is width -- every run in this cell has had model_dim exactly 512, so ASPECT_RATIO up to put model_dim at 640 (e.g. DEPTH 10, ASPECT_RATIO 64 -> base 640, 5 heads of 128) is the natural next probe, and it also tests whether the shape (depth/width ratio) or just the parameter count is what has been paying.
